info.title: DragonByte eCommerce API
info.description: The REST API added by DragonByte eCommerce, a third-party XenForo add-on. Transcribed by hand from the add-on's @api annotations, entity setupApiResultData() and controller input filters.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Whether to fetch all products on a single page.

parameters.name: platforms[]
parameters.description: Only products matching these product filter IDs.

parameters.name: prefix_id
parameters.description: Filters to only products with the specified prefix.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filters to only products of the specified type: free, paid.

parameters.name: creator_id
parameters.description: Filters to only products owned by the specified user ID.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Method of ordering: last_update, creation_date, rating_weighted, title. Featured products always sort first.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Either "asc" or "desc". Applies only if an order is provided.

get.summary: Get the products the current user holds a license for
get.description: Get the products the current user holds a visible license for. Not paginated; an empty list when there are none. Where the board filters licenses by license field, only licenses matching the X-DragonByte-BoardUrl header count.

get.summary: Get the downloads of the specified product
get.description: Get the downloads of the specified product. An empty list when no version matches. Where the board filters licenses by license field, only licenses matching the X-DragonByte-BoardUrl header count.

parameters.name: product_version_type
parameters.description: "demo" or "full".

get.summary: Get the latest download of the specified product
get.description: Get the latest download matching the parameters. Answers 404 no_downloadable_version_found when there is none. Where the board filters licenses by license field, only licenses matching the X-DragonByte-BoardUrl header count.

get.summary: Download the file of one version of the specified download
get.description: The file itself, not JSON. An external download answers 301 to where it is hosted. A refusal answers 403 you_have_not_purchased_any_licenses_yet or license_does_not_permit_download. Where the board filters licenses by license field, only licenses matching the X-DragonByte-BoardUrl header count.

parameters.description: Which product version.

parameters.name: product_version_type
parameters.description: "demo" or "full".

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Attachment ID, where the version has more than one file.

get.description: Get the current user's licenses. Not paginated; an empty list when there are none. Where the board filters licenses by license field, only licenses matching the X-DragonByte-BoardUrl header count.
